result.summary: The page is largely well-composed, but one clear data-rendering defect stands out: a restaurant card shows '€NaN delivery', indicating a broken numeric value. A couple of smaller cosmetic inconsistencies (range dash typography, inconsistent favorite-button treatment) are also present. Partially visible carousel items and the bottom-cut card were treated as intended behavior.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card in 'Fastest near you' displays '€NaN delivery' — an unformatted/undefined numeric value leaking into the UI instead of a price.
issues.suggestion: Fix the delivery-fee data/formatting pipeline: validate the value before rendering and fall back to a sensible label (e.g. 'Free delivery' or 'Delivery fee unavailable') when the fee is null/undefined, so 'NaN' never reaches the screen.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) button on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has no visible circular background, while the same button on the pizza card below sits on a dark translucent circle. On the light/busy ramen artwork the outlined heart is harder to see and the treatment is inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same translucent dark circular scrim behind the heart icon on all restaurant cards to guarantee contrast and visual consistency.

issues.description: Time ranges use a mathematical minus sign ('15−25 min', '20−30 min', '25−35 min') rather than an en dash, which reads oddly and can be mispronounced by screen readers.
issues.suggestion: Use an en dash with the word 'to' for assistive tech (e.g. '15–25 min' with aria-label '15 to 25 minutes') for correct typography and clearer semantics.
